snippet.title: DUELGROUNDS | ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4801180/Duelgrounds/

Duelgrounds is a fast-paced 1v1 FPS where precision, movement, and strategy decide every match. Face your opponent in intense duels, master your weapons, and prove your skills! In addition to its competitive 1v1 gameplay, Duelgrounds also features a 3–6 player Prop Hunt mode for a fun and unpredictable multiplayer experience!
